claim: Patchline ships a certified-integration badge program with at least ten third-party tools passing conformance. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the conformance claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make certified-integration-badges-gate`.
